## Summary

I extended the business-day rule in `OwnerRestControllerV1.toBusinessDay(...)` so the registration date now rolls past public holidays as well as weekends.

**Change** (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`):

- Added a `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` set with the fixed dates: `2026-01-01`, `2026-01-26`, `2026-04-25`, `2026-12-25`, `2026-12-28`.
- Rewrote `toBusinessDay` to advance the date one day at a time while it falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or a listed holiday — so a date landing on a holiday rolls forward to the next non-holiday business day (correctly handling holiday→weekend and back-to-back holiday chains like Dec 25 → Dec 28).

This mirrors the reference algorithm in the acceptance test base (`AcceptanceBase.toBusinessDay`), and the new holiday-focused `Cp47Tests` plus all existing tests pass.
